title: Full function across the supply range
procedure: Run open, close, express open and express close at 9.0 V, 13.5 V and 16.0 V.
pass_criteria: All four movements complete at each voltage.

title: Manual mode only at low voltage
procedure: At 7.5 V, give a short press (200 ms) and a held press (2 s) in each direction.
pass_criteria: Short press gives no movement; held press moves the window.

title: Motor stop at undervoltage
procedure: Start closing at 13.5 V, then drop the supply to 5.5 V within 1 ms.
pass_criteria: Motor command off within 50 ms of the supply crossing 6.0 V.

title: Sleep current
procedure: Put the controller to sleep, wait 60 s, measure supply current for 10 s.
pass_criteria: Mean current below 100 µA.

title: Reverse polarity
procedure: Apply -14 V for 60 s, then run TC-PW-01 at 13.5 V.
pass_criteria: No damage; TC-PW-01 passes afterwards.

title: Wake-up time
procedure: From sleep, press the switch up.
pass_criteria: Motor command within 100 ms of the press.

title: Manual movement and stop on release
procedure: Hold the switch for 1.5 s in each direction, then release.
pass_criteria: Window moves while held; motor command off within 100 ms of release.

title: Retained power after ignition off
procedure: Switch ignition off; press the switch at 40 s and at 50 s; repeat with a front door opened at 10 s.
pass_criteria: Movement at 40 s; no movement at 50 s; no movement after the door is opened.

title: Express start on short press
procedure: Press the switch for 200 ms in each direction.
pass_criteria: Window travels to the end position.

title: Express stop by second press
procedure: Start express close, press the switch again after 1 s.
pass_criteria: Motor command off within 100 ms of the second press.

title: Full close time
procedure: At 13.5 V and 23 °C, express close from fully open.
pass_criteria: Close time from 3.0 s to 4.5 s.

title: Stop at end positions
procedure: Express open and express close to the end positions.
pass_criteria: Motor command off at the end position.

title: Close on rain
procedure: With the window half open, send a rain signal.
pass_criteria: Window closes.

title: Express close only when normalized
procedure: Disconnect the supply for 1 s, then give a short press up.
pass_criteria: No express movement until normalized.

title: Pinch detection at nominal voltage
procedure: At 13.5 V and 23 °C, express close onto the 10 N/mm pinch rod placed at 100 mm.
pass_criteria: Motor stops within 10 ms of the force exceeding 100 N; reversal of at least 125 mm.

title: Pinch detection at low voltage
procedure: As TC-AP-01 at 9.0 V.
pass_criteria: As TC-AP-01.

title: Pinch detection at high voltage
procedure: As TC-AP-01 at 16.0 V.
pass_criteria: As TC-AP-01.

title: Pinch detection when cold
procedure: As TC-AP-01 at 9.0 V and -30 °C.
pass_criteria: As TC-AP-01.

title: Pinch detection when hot
procedure: As TC-AP-01 at 13.5 V and 85 °C.
pass_criteria: As TC-AP-01.

title: Pinch protection in manual and express mode
procedure: Repeat TC-AP-01 with a held switch (manual) and a short press (express).
pass_criteria: Pinch detected in both modes.

title: Anti-pinch off when not normalized
procedure: Disconnect the supply for 1 s, close manually onto the pinch rod.
pass_criteria: No reversal.

title: Repeated pinch lockout
procedure: Cause three pinches within 20 s, then try express close.
pass_criteria: Express close refused for 60 s; manual close possible.

title: Disturbance robustness
procedure: Close on the rough-road vibration profile.
pass_criteria: No false pinch detection.

title: Position resolution
procedure: Move the window 10 mm in manual mode and compare with the bench encoder.
pass_criteria: Position step 0.5 mm or smaller.

title: Loss of normalization
procedure: Interrupt the supply for 400 ms and for 600 ms.
pass_criteria: Normalized after 400 ms; not normalized after 600 ms.

title: Normalization at top seal
procedure: From not normalized, hold the switch up against the seal for 1.2 s.
pass_criteria: Normalization state set in WLC_Status.

title: Thermal model accuracy
procedure: Run 20 open-close cycles with a thermocouple on the motor housing.
pass_criteria: Model within 10 °C of the measured temperature.

title: Current reduction at the temperature limit
procedure: Run open-close cycles until the estimated temperature exceeds the limit.
pass_criteria: Motor current reduced.

title: Opening blocked when hot
procedure: Run open-close cycles until the estimated temperature exceeds 140 °C, then press open.
pass_criteria: No opening above 140 °C; closing still possible.

title: Thermal block release
procedure: After TC-TH-03, wait for cooling and press open.
pass_criteria: Opening possible below 120 °C.

title: WLC_Status timing and content
procedure: Record WLC_Status for 10 s while moving the window.
pass_criteria: Period 100 ms ± 10 ms; all four signals present.

title: Hall sensor loss
procedure: While closing, disconnect the Hall sensor signal.
pass_criteria: B1A01 stored and motor stopped about 200 ms after the loss.

title: Overcurrent
procedure: Block the window and inject 27 A for 100 ms.
pass_criteria: B1A02 stored, motor stopped, fault state set.

title: Diagnostic response time
procedure: Send 100 diagnostic requests.
pass_criteria: Every response within 50 ms.

title: Climatic operation
procedure: Run TC-PW-01 at -40 °C and at 85 °C.
pass_criteria: All movements complete.

title: Usability review
procedure: Five drivers rate switch feel and response.
pass_criteria: Average rating 4 of 5 or better.
